newsitem.title: YEMEN: Dutch grant Yemen $34 mln for power plant.
newsitem.headline: Dutch grant Yemen $34 mln for power plant.

text.p: The Netherlands on Monday granted Yemen 60 million guilders ($34 million) to build a power station in the southeastern city of Mukalla, a Yemeni official said.
"(The deal) was signed today (Monday)...stipulating that the Dutch government will provide Yemen with a grant of 60 million guilders," the official told Reuters.
The project to build the power station in Mukalla, about 780 km (470) miles east of the capital Sanaa, would be carried out by Dutch industrial group Stork, he said.
The capacity in the first stage of the project would be 40-megawatt. The official did not say what the plant's final capacity would be.
"The Yemeni government will cover the remaining 40 percent of the total project cost," he said.
In September Mukalla was the scene of violent demonstrations as citizens protested against a severe shortage of electricity and water. Mukalla is the capital of the oil-producing province Hadhramaut.
